faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about pricing and billing.

study.a: A study is a single analysis of your product using AI. This includes heuristic evaluations, cognitive walkthroughs, and persona-based assessments. Each study deducts a fixed cost from your balance.

billing.a: You fund your account with money, which is used to run studies. Each study costs a fixed amount based on your plan. Add funds whenever you're ready — your balance never expires and there are no minimums.

difference.q: What's the difference between Individual and Team pricing?
difference.a: Individual pricing starts from {personalCost}/study. Team pricing starts from {companyCost}/study and includes company and team management features, custom heuristics, and collaboration tools designed for organizations.

try.q: Can I try Seer before purchasing?
try.a: Yes! Every new user gets 3 free studies to run at no cost. Experience the full platform before committing.

expire.a: No, your balance never expires. Use it at your own pace — it'll be waiting whenever you need it.

limits.q: Are there limits on team size or usage?
limits.a: Team plans have no limits on team members, viewers, or studies. Individual plans support up to 10 screens per study. Team plans have no screen limits, though we recommend keeping flows under 25 screens for optimal results. Run as many studies as your balance allows.

setup.q: How do I set up my company on Seer?
setup.a: It's completely self-service! Sign up with your work email, then claim your company's domain from account settings. Your colleagues can then join automatically when they sign up with the same email domain. No forms, no waiting.

upgrade.q: How do I upgrade from Individual to Team?
upgrade.a: It's simple and self-service! Just claim your company's domain or join an existing company from your account settings. No sales calls or approvals needed — start collaborating with your team immediately.

methods.q: What payment methods do you accept?
methods.a: We accept all major credit cards. For enterprise billing or invoicing, please contact payments@askseer.ai.

secure.a: Yes. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Your uploads and data are never used to train AI models. Enterprise-grade security protects your sensitive designs.
